timing: Host wall time with explicit completion; three warmups; serialized changing queries; scan/control exclude query preparation; search includes normalization, query publication, selection and readback. GB/s uses unpadded FP16 vector bytes and decimal GB.
validation: Sampled scores include the allocation tail and 4 GiB boundary; all returned scores checked against quantized CPU reference. Full ranking correctness is covered by the GPU test suite, not a 10M-row CPU sort in this benchmark.
resource_collection: ELF register and scratch metadata added after measurement with llvm-readobj; the 1%/VGPR tie rule was then applied. Timings are unchanged.
